_comment: GCB-030 - EPIC TKT-018 Measurement Epoch Story 3, per TKT-000. Enable synthesis register retiming (ORFS SYNTH_RETIME_MODULES -> abc -dff -script abc_retime.script) and re-measure gcb_max_reduce REG_STAGES=2. EXACT same flow as GCB-029, ONE config line added: SYNTH_RETIME_MODULES = gcb_max_reduce. RTL frozen. Raw measurement.
params: WIDTH=16 N_ELEMENTS=64 OUTPUT=BOTH REG_STAGES=2  (2 output pipeline stages, retimed by abc)

flow.identical_to: GCB-029 (same sv2v netlist, same constraint.sdc @ 1000 ps, same floorplan/place/route knobs, default recipe)
flow.only_diff: export SYNTH_RETIME_MODULES = gcb_max_reduce  -> ORFS synth.tcl runs: select gcb_max_reduce; opt -fast -full; memory_map; opt -full; techmap; abc -dff -script scripts/abc_retime.script (st; retime -v -o; retime -M 5 -v -o x3; map)

worst_slack_ps.note: tightest path now reg->reg through a tree segment (_09012_ -> out_valid$_DFF); +31 ps

max_slew_violation_count.note: NEW DRV - retiming's 818-flop fan-out on data/reset nets, not cleaned by the default (no-last-gasp) recipe

flop_count_DFFASRHQN.note: retiming REPLICATES a register pushed backward through a fan-out node; the 2 output pipe stages fan out across the whole 64-wide tournament tree -> 46 -> 818

HAxp5_count.note: some index arithmetic absorbed/re-optimised once registers land mid-datapath

power_total_W.note: combinational power 17.4->8.6 mW - shorter segments glitch less; +sequential 2.44 mW + clock 1.12 mW for the 818-flop tree

cts.gcb030: 818 clock sinks, tree depth 2, 41 clusters - a real clock tree now exists

critical_path.worst_path_type: register -> register through a SEGMENT of the tournament tree (e.g. _09012_ -> out_valid$_DFF_PN0_, +31.24 ps slack). No longer input -> max_val combinational.
critical_path.async_reset_barrier: NO - abc retimed straight through the DFFASRHQN async-set/reset flops; all 818 result flops are DFFASRHQN.
critical_path.new_paths: reg->reg tree segments (MET), plus async recovery/removal checks on rst_n -> the retimed flops (MET, +131 to +567 ps).

orange_verdict: Retiming CLOSES 1 ns for gcb_max_reduce @ REG_STAGES=2 (WNS -442 -> 0 ps, 22 -> 0 setup violations, cone broken into reg->reg segments) - it does move the output pipe registers up into the tree. BUT the cost is steep: retiming REPLICATES the 46 flops 17.8x to 818 (register duplication across the 64-wide tree fan-out), +63% cell area, +30 pts sequential-area fraction, +17% wirelength, and 57 NEW max-slew DRVs. Power drops 31% (shorter combinational segments). The GCB-029-falsified assumption is re-validated WITH a large caveat: retiming works but at a register/area/DRV cost that says the pipeline should be expressed in the RTL (mid-tree cuts), not synthesised by replication.
decision: Retiming is a valid path but the 818-flop / +63%-area / 57-slew-DRV cost for a shared 3-site primitive argues for hypothesis 2 (a mid-tree pipelined gcb_max_reduce RTL variant: REG_STAGES as tree-cut count -> ~2xWIDTH flops, timing closes without replication). File that as GCB-###. If the 818 flops are acceptable, the alternative is a small GCB-### to set SYNTH_RETIME_MODULES in the shared flow config + a slew-repair pass (SKIP_LAST_GASP=0) and re-measure the DRV/area.
